1 (Currently Amended): A belly pan for a motor vehicle, comprising: a body panel having a forward section constructed from an open rib structure and being reinforced by a plurality of ribs, wherein said plurality of ribs includes at least two closed ribs in series with said open rib structure; and an aero cover carried on said body panel and spanning said open rib structure.

5 (Currently Amended): The belly pan of claim 4, wherein said first section of open rib structure includes a first fore-aft rib and a first plurality of transverse ribs projecting from opposed sides of said first fore-aft rib, with said first fore-aft rib being substantially more rigid than at least one of said transverse ribs.

11 (Currently Amended): The belly pan of claim 10, wherein said body panel is made from a material having a tensile and flexural modulus of at least 10 GPa, with a specific gravity that is less than 1.5.

12 (Currently Amended): The belly pan of claim 11, wherein said body panel is molded from polypropylene reinforced with 50% long glass fibers.

14 (Currently Amended): The belly pan of claim 13, wherein said first aero cover and said second aero cover have a total thickness of about 3.0 mm.
